title: Vinland Saga
subtitle: The strength that refuses the sword
_guide_hero: Layout: Title (1-4 words), jpTitle (1-3 words), subtitle (3-6 words). Poster is right split image (2:3 portrait).

entry._guide: Layout: Centered giant text. Limit 15-40 words.
entry.breathQuote: I came for the Vikings — the shield walls, the raids, violence drawn beautifully. I think I was at a stage where I wanted strength to be simple.

reflection._guide: Layout: Right column split. Quote: 20-50 words. Tags: 2-4 items. Cards: 30-70 words.
reflection.quote: It took me two seasons to realize the strongest man in the story was the one who refused to fight. I kept waiting for the twist. The twist was the whole point.
reflection.whatIKept: Revenge is a job you can't quit and never get paid for. Thorfinn spent a decade making it his whole identity, and the show never let me admire him for it.
reflection.definingScene: The knife left in the dirt. After ten years of carrying it, he simply walked away and started working a field — no speech, no thunder. I'd never seen strength look like that.
reflection.whoItMadeMeThinkAbout: The grudges I still carry — and what my life would look like if I put them down.

thoughtCascade.thought: This is a revenge story. I know where it's going.
Wait — the warrior he admires is the one who refused to fight.
A decade of hatred hasn't made him strong. It's made him hollow.
He threw the knife away and something in my chest loosened.
I rewatched the wheat field scene three times.

_guide_thoughtCascade: Layout: Left-aligned timeline. Thought: 20-45 words. Micro: 2-5 words.

cinematicMoment._guide: Layout: Full width dark section. Body: 40-80 words. Image: 16:9 landscape.
cinematicMoment.title: The knife in the dirt.
cinematicMoment.body: All those years, all that hatred, and he just left it in the ground. He didn't forgive — he released. I had confused the two my whole life.

memoryCards._guide: Layout: Hovering glass cards. Question: 5-12 words. Cards: text 30-50 words.
memoryCards.question: What stayed with me after the screen went dark?

cards.title: The Knife
cards.text: Left in the ground. You can walk away from your own anger — it doesn't have to write the rest of your sentence.

cards.title: The Field
cards.text: Ordinary work done with your hands, until the poison leaves. Healing looks boring.

cards.title: The Line
cards.text: 'I have no enemies.' Not a slogan — a way of seeing that ends the war before it starts.

altMemories.question: What quietly changed?
altMemories.heading: I stopped calling anger 'motivation.'
altMemories.body: I used the same fuel Thorfinn did — resentment as a productivity hack. Watching a decade of it produce nothing but exhaustion made me audit my own.
altMemories.caption: Hatred is expensive fuel.

altMemories.question: What did I misunderstand?
altMemories.heading: I thought Askeladd was the villain.
altMemories.body: He was the mirror — a man who used everyone's hatred as fuel, including Thorfinn's. He showed me how clever people cash in other people's pain.
altMemories.caption: The puppet masters live among us.

_guide_altMemories: Layout: Alternating split layout. Body: 50-100 words. Image: 1:1 or 4:5.

pullQuote._guide: Layout: Giant dramatic quote. Text: 10-30 words.
pullQuote.text: You have no enemies. No one in this world has enemies.

timeline._guide: Layout: Center timeline nodes. Body: 30-60 words.

firstImpression.heading: A brutal revenge saga
firstImpression.body: I expected a samurai-in-a-shield-wall story: blood, honor, and a satisfying kill.

whatShifted.heading: The farm changed everything
whatShifted.body: Half a season of planting wheat and hauling timber — and it was the most radical thing the show could do. Work, not war, as the path back to yourself.

whatStayed.heading: True strength
whatStayed.body: The man who needs no sword. Not a pacifist creed — an engineering decision about what actually works.

items.line: when I'm rehearsing an old grievance instead of doing the work in front of me.
to leave the knife in the ground.
what I'd do with all the energy my anger has been holding hostage.

characters.name: Thorfinn
characters.mirror: He reflected the years of my own life I spent running on resentment. Watching him stop was watching a door open.

characters.name: Askeladd
characters.mirror: He showed me how easy it is to be the smartest person in the room and the emptiest. I recognized the trick before I recognized the cost.

characters.name: Einar
characters.mirror: He chooses kindness with both eyes open. He taught me that gentleness is a practice, not a personality.

notes.text: Revenge is a job you can't quit and never get paid for.
The strongest warrior in the show refuses to hold a sword. I keep coming back to why that feels true.

ideas.application: Strength as the ability to not respond — to absorb the opening and decline it.
Forgiveness as a destination you sail toward, not a single arrival. You have to keep the ship pointed.

continueJourney.because: Because I stopped believing my anger was my best work.
